references.context: General topology: a continuous map f:X→Y is a closed map if every closed F⊆X has closed image f(F)⊆Y; here it is the underlying continuous map of a scheme base change, without a Hausdorff or properness assumption.
references.reason: Closedness of a continuous map is reusable independently of the stronger scheme-universally-closed condition.
